BiblicalUsage: Jeshishai is an Israelite, a son of Abihail of Gad. In 1 Chronicles 5:14, the son of Jeshishai.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jeshishai shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
